title: vLLM MoE top-k gating softmax

computation.summary: Each row of expert scores is softmaxed, then the top k=2 experts are selected by repeated arg-max. Selected weights, expert indices and source rows are written; renormalize is on and the routed scaling factor is 1.0.
computation.caption: input holds scores; output, indices and source_rows share the rows × k shape as separate allocations. finished, bias and is_padding are null inputs.

finding.summary: Analysis stopped in the frontend at a branch after the selection loop's output stores; memory analysis was not completed and no race verdict exists. The branch compares the lane's slot with a slot derived from the selected expert index, which depends on unsupplied input scores.

code.caption: The stopping comparison, its branch, and the local scratch write the forward branch can bypass.
code.roles: %r3 is the lane's slot (tid.x & 15). %r116 is a slot computed from the selected expert index %r22. The store writes a sentinel into local scratch, not global memory.
code.scope: Eligibility only: this does not show which lanes write, and the stop means later code was not analyzed.

next: Provide or constrain the input score values (or a branch decision for this predicate) so the selected expert index, and hence the slot comparison, can be resolved; then rerun the analysis.

source_sections.title: Why the predicate is not static
source_sections.answer: The tested slot %r116 comes from the arg-max expert index %r22, which is derived from loaded input scores. Only scalar arguments and null pointers were supplied, so nothing fixes it.

steps.label: Lane slot
steps.text: %r3 = tid.x & 15 (line 73), known per lane from the launch.

steps.label: Owner slot
steps.text: %r116 is computed at lines 342-350 from %r22, the winning index selected at lines 227-307 from values loaded by ld.global.v4.f32 at line 81 from the input object. Its contents were not supplied.

steps.label: Comparison
steps.text: Line 351 sets %p68 = (%r3 != %r116); line 352 branches to $L__BB7_23 on it. It is reached only if the loop-exit test at lines 340-341 falls through; full-path reachability was not proved.

source_sections.title: What the branch skips
source_sections.answer: When %p68 is true the branch jumps over a st.local.u32 that writes a sentinel (bit pattern -971227136) into the per-thread local array. It does not skip global stores.

steps.label: Skipped
steps.text: Lines 353-363 compute a local address from %r22 and store the sentinel at %rd34, based on %rd2 (the local depot).

steps.label: Rejoin
steps.text: Both paths meet at $L__BB7_23 (line 364), which advances the loop counters.

source_sections.title: Configured scalar contributions
source_sections.answer: Configured arguments resolve several earlier gates, but not this one: renormalize is 1, and finished, bias and is_padding are null pointers, so their guarded loads are bypassed where those definitions are reached.

steps.label: Null pointers
steps.text: %p15 (line 61), %p28 (line 192) and %p63 (line 309) test finished, bias and is_padding against zero and are true, so the loads at lines 67, 197-203 and 312 are bypassed if reached.

steps.label: Renormalize
steps.text: %p64 and %p71 (lines 320, 375) test renormalize == 0 and are false, so the running sum at lines 336-337 is accumulated.
